02 · 13th month basics

The rules behind the number

When to pay

By Wednesday, December 23, 2026. December 24 is the legal deadline, but it's a special non-working day this year. Keep proof of payment for each employee.

Who is covered

Rank-and-file employees who worked at least one month during the calendar year.

How it's computed

Basic salary earned ÷ 12. Leave out OT, premiums, holiday pay, night differential and allowances.

Leavers

Pro-rata 13th month, paid with final pay within 30 days of separation.

The rest of year-end, month by month24 checks from October to March, plus every BIR, DOLE and pay date you can add to your calendar.

Start the year-end checklist

There's always a better way

Skip the one-by-one checks.
Catch errors before payday.

PeoplesHR works from the same payroll data for every employee, so 13th month and the ₱90,000 bucket don't need checking one person at a time.

And anomaly detection flags anything unusual before you run payroll, not after payslips go out.
